sources_tried: Seed file sacramento.json: worked. Of about 45 maps rows, most were remodelers, tile shops and stores. Partition Specialties Inc (psi3g.com, West Sacramento) turned out to sell operable walls and access floors, not toilet partitions, so it was excluded.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loaded but the rep dropdown didn't render, so no data.
Bradley find-a-rep: page loaded with no content.
Metpar representatives: 404. Hadrian find-a-rep: 404. General Partitions and Ampco: not tried after the other locators failed.
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): 403 blocked on every profile; only search snippets were used.
BuildingConnected and Procore public profiles: not reached within the search cap.

WebSearch (8 of 8 used): 'toilet partition installation Sacramento contractor', 'New West Partitions Sacramento' (it is a drywall and metal-stud framing sub, excluded), 'Wilson Partitions West Sacramento' (a manufacturer in Vernon, CA, excluded), 'Division 10 toilet partitions installer Sacramento/Roseville/Rancho Cordova/West Sacramento', 'Delta Specialties', 'bathroom partition installers Roseville Elk Grove Folsom', and 'yelp toilet partitions Sacramento'. These worked, but mostly returned national distributors (One Point Partitions, Newton Distributing, Prestige Distribution: no local base, excluded) and Magnum Drywall (Division 10 installer based in San Jose, outside the 30-mile radius, excluded).
Company sites: stumbaugh.com worked; prowestwall.com worked; asmp-div10.com returned 503 three times; onepointpartitions.com returned 403.
Yelp and BBB: no Yelp or BBB pages came up in the search results.

candidates.name: Stumbaugh & Associates, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage calls it the largest provider of restroom partitions and accessories in California and says it offers professional installation services. The contact page has an 'Estimates & Installation' email for installation scheduling and site visits.
red_flags: Sells partitions material-only, including walk-in and showroom sales, so there is a buy-around risk
The Northern California office uses a 650 area code
Corporate office is in Burbank. West Sacramento is a branch office.
candidates.reason: A commercial restroom partition contractor with a West Sacramento branch that sources and installs partitions. It is also a direct seller of partitions, so it competes with us on supply.

license.note: CSLB record (data current as of 11/19/2026): Stumbaugh & Associates Inc, current and active, issued 11/19/1973, expires 04/30/2028; contractor's bond (Merchants Bonding Co., $25,000) and workers' comp (Arch Insurance, 03/01/2026 to 03/01/2027) on file. Sacramento's local rule (business operations tax paid at permit issuance) has no online registry to check.
